cases.task: Choose the safe server-side pacing rule when an SSE event projection reports has_more=true continuously because new events arrive at least as fast as pages are drained.

required_facts.text: Continuing immediately for every has_more page can monopolize projection and flush work indefinitely under continuous ingestion.
Finite backlog should still drain promptly without sleeping after every page.
Cursor progress and page delivery must be preserved; pacing must not drop or rewind events.
